articles.summary: WCG and ICON Partner to Advance Data-Driven Clinical Trial Site Selection Vincent.Foster Fri, 11/20/2026 - 11:06 WCG and ICON Partner to Advance Data-Driven Clinical Trial Site Selection Page tools Share Share Share on Linkedin Share on Bluesky Share on X Share on Facebook ICON will have access to WCG's Trial IntelX™ benchmarking datasets to support its feasibility and site selection activities CARY, NC, 23 November, 2026 — WCG, a global leader in providing solutions that measurably improve and accelerate clinical research, today announced a five-year agreement with ICON plc, a world-leading clinical research organization, providing integrated clinical solutions across the development lifecycle. Under the agreement, ICON will have access to WCG's Trial IntelX™ benchmarking datasets to support its feasibility and site selection activities. Selecting suitable countries, sites and investigators requires an assessment of historical performance, participant availability, protocol requirements and local clinical practices. Trial IntelX draws on more than 44,000 operationally benchmarked clinical trials and more than one million site records across more than 140 countries, with data vetted, standardized, and submitted directly from sponsors, sites, and CROs. The platform allows research teams to compare investigator track records, site-level performance, enrollment patterns, and geographic considerations using historical trial data. ICON’s feasibility and site-identification teams combine clinical trial intelligence, medical informatics, regulatory insights and direct investigator input to develop study-specific recommendations. OneSearch, ICON’s human-enabled, AI-powered site targeting tool uses patient records and historical site data to rank and recommend suitable sites. WCG’s Trial IntelX benchmarking datasets provide an additional source of site and investigator performance benchmarks to support ICON’s feasibility and site selection activities. “The decisions made before first patient in can shape everything that follows. Historical performance benchmarks provide a valuable perspective when assessing sites and investigators.” said Mette Andersen, general manager, Data, Analytics, and Insights Solutions, WCG. “Our Trial IntelX data lets teams see how sites and investigators have actually performed in comparable trials. “This agreement brings WCG’s benchmarking data together with ICON’s clinical and operational expertise, supporting the assessment of potential sites against the requirements of individual studies.” “Our sponsors ask us a version of the same question on every program: which sites will deliver?” said Brian Mallon, executive vice president, Sites, Patients & Study Start Up at ICON. “WCG's benchmarking data complements our operational experience and our own datasets with an additional objective, industry-wide view of site and investigator performance. For sponsors, we bring these insights together to identify suitable sites and support more informed decisions about recruitment potential and study start-up.” Explore ICON’s approach to feasibility and site identification at https://www.iconplc.com/startup . To learn more about Trial IntelX visit https://www.wcgclinical.com/technologies/trial-intelx/ . About WCG WCG is the decision infrastructure of clinical research, combining trusted oversight with intelligence that scales judgment and reduces risk across the trial lifecycle. With decades of experience and the industry’s deepest dataset powering responsible AI, we help teams make confident decisions that keep trials moving forward for therapies at every stage of development. For more information, please visit wcgclinical.com or follow us on LinkedIn . About ICON plc ICON plc is a world-leading clinical research organisation. Offering deep operational and medical expertise we accelerate innovation, driving emerging therapies forward to improve patient outcomes. From molecule to medicine, we deliver integrated consulting, clinical development, commercialisation and post-marketing solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, government and public health organisations worldwide. With headquarters in Dublin, Ireland, ICON employed approximately 40,250 employees in 98 locations in 55 countries as at September 30, 2026. For further information about ICON, visit: www.iconplc.com . articles.summary: ICON launches FIRECREST AI-directed video engine Iuliia.Krutikova Thu, 11/05/2026 - 13:00 ICON launches FIRECREST AI-directed video engine, changing the economics of site communications Page tools Share Share Share on Linkedin Share on Bluesky Share on X Share on Facebook Dublin, Ireland – 5 November 2026 – ICON plc (NASDAQ: ICLR), a world-leading clinical research organisation, today announced the release of AI-directed video production capabilities within its FIRECREST site & patient communications platform. ICON’s FIRECREST AI-directed video engine enables sponsors to automate the creation of high-quality, high-impact clinical trial videos. Unlike generic and unrestricted generative AI video tools, ICON’s FIRECREST empowers sponsors by delivering consistent, scalable and governed video output for regulated clinical trial environments, at speeds and scale that would previously have been prohibitively expensive. The structured communication approach, templates, governance, and production methodology are predefined by ICON and sponsor subject matter experts, while AI executes and scales the production process. Video production timelines are reduced approximately 10x, from days to hours. Sponsors maintain full control of production, review and launch processes, whilst all sponsor-confidential information is stored within ICON's secure environment. With over half a million site users worldwide, and over five million clinical study related trainings delivered via the platform, FIRECREST creates a consistent operating model for site engagement across a Sponsor’s portfolio. The new AI-directed video engine leverages a rich library of proven content and templates, developed over more than 25 years of ICON’s experience creating study communications with its FIRECREST platform. The platform's first application supports site selection and feasibility activities, converting study-specific information into engaging site selection videos that help investigator sites quickly understand research opportunities and study requirements. “Clinical trials rely on effective communication with investigator sites,” said Brian Mallon, Executive Vice President, Site & Patient Solutions at ICON plc. “Video is a powerful communication format, and ICON’s AI-directed video engine removes cost and complexity, and is far faster than traditional video production, enabling sponsors to scale communication and deliver greater site engagement and message consistency, whilst maintaining governance and reducing risk”.
